sample_unit: ANN architectures under varying training dataset sizes and label corruption percentages

links.outcome: Performance of five ANN architectures under label corruption at varying training set sizes
links.effect: Architectures produced different results for the same task with and without dataset modification; label corruption produced a mixture of metric tendencies, making corruption hard to detect.
links.quote: We also found that label corruption resulted in a mixture of performance metrics tendencies, indicating that it is difficult to conclude whether label corruption has occurred.

unlisted_practices: Selecting ANN architecture with consideration of ethical implications and robustness to label corruption
Detecting label corruption or mislabeling in training datasets

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the robustness of five ANN architectures against simulated label corruption/noise in medical image datasets.
